title: Something Big Is Coming for Aquarius
script_text: Something monumental is reshaping your entire path this week, Aquarius. Pluto's trine to Jupiter in your 5th House of Romance is fueling creative confidence all week long. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury's sextile to Uranus in your 3rd House gives your communication sharp, magnetic clarity — pitch those bold ideas early. Hold off on any major financial decisions Wednesday when the Moon squares Saturn. Thursday shifts everything as Venus enters your 7th House of Partnership, igniting powerful romantic energy and soulmate attraction. Through the weekend, Mars in your 10th House supercharges career ambition while your air element drives bold networking wins Friday and Saturday. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House unlocking love magic. Wednesday is your worst day because the Moon squares Saturn creating emotional friction. Trust that tempting career offer arriving soon — Jupiter's trine is opening rare doorways for you. Follow for daily updates.
